SQL query on every request. Every page view of every page embedding this forum's comments now costs a database round-trip on the public embed path that previously served from the settings cache, adding DB load proportional to embed traffic (and the migration creates no index on host).

adjudication.rationale: The diff changes embed authorization to call `EmbeddableHost.host_allowed?(request.referer)` (app/controllers/embed_controller.rb), which calls `record_for_host` and executes `where("lower(host) = ?", host).first` (app/models/embeddable_host.rb). The migration creating `embeddable_hosts` adds no index on `host` (or a functional index on `lower(host)`), so this introduces a DB query on the public embed path that is plausibly unindexed and per-request, whereas the previous `SiteSetting.embeddable_hosts` check was in-process/cached. This is a concrete performance/architecture concern evidenced by the diff, not a functional correctness bug.
